description: Alpha Vantage global quote for one stock or ETF ticker: price, open/high/low, volume, previous close and change, from Alpha Vantage's free API. Needs a free Alpha Vantage API key (ALPHAVANTAGE_API_KEY); free keys are rate limited. Usually answers in about 7 s, up to 22 s on slower calls; allow a 45 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: finance_iex_cloud_public when you need Real-time US stock, ETF or index quote: company name. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
